block.dopasrandomutilities.item_collecto: Collects items in a configurable range
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.sola: A furnace powered by sunlight instead of fuel. It needs clear sky access above the block.

Sunlight is weakest at sunrise and sunset, and strongest at noon. Peak speed is about 70% of a normal furnace. Rain reduces output significantly, and thunderstorms reduce it even more. The furnace stops completely at night or when the sky is blocked.
block.dopasrandomutilities.simple_block_: Breaks the block in front on a redstone pulse
Places a block in front on a redstone pulse
block.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_bloc: Breaks blocks in a configurable volume
Places blocks in a configurable volume
When disabled, place and break sounds are skipped. The machine still works.
These sliders change the color of the range highlight
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.simp: On a redstone pulse, picks a random block from its slots and places it in front of its face.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.adva:
Places blocks inside a configurable volume while redstone allows it.

Base cycle is 40 ticks. Overclock upgrades make it faster (down to 1 tick). Energy cost scales with distance and speed, and can be reduced with Efficiency upgrades.

Picks a random block from its inventory, just like a dispenser.

Breaks blocks inside a configurable volume while redstone allows it.

Base cycle is 40 ticks. Overclock upgrades make it faster (down to 1 tick). Energy cost scales with distance and speed, and can be reduced with Efficiency upgrades. Harder blocks take multiple hits and extra energy.

An empty pickaxe slot uses diamond harvest level. Inserting a pickaxe applies its mining level, Fortune, Silk Touch, and Unbreaking.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.fish:
Place it waterlogged with water sources on all four sides. Insert a fishing rod to catch fish and junk. Rod enchantments apply and the rod takes durability.

Fortune Mesh unlocks vanilla treasure in open water. Treasure Mesh replaces all loot with a custom table.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.fishnet.need_wa: Needs to be waterlogged with water sources on all four sides
jei.dopasrandomutilities.fishnet.info:
An automated fishing trap.

Place it waterlogged so every horizontal side touches a water source, then insert a fishing rod. Rod enchantments (Lure, Luck of the Sea, Unbreaking) apply and the rod loses durability with each catch.

Without Fortune Mesh it only catches fish and junk. Fortune Mesh unlocks vanilla treasure in open water (up to 90% force chance). Treasure Mesh replaces all loot with a custom table and overwrites Fortune Mesh.

A swimming fish animation plays just before each catch finishes.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.simple_block_br:
Place facing any direction (including up or down). A redstone pulse breaks the block directly in front of it.

Uses iron mining level. Soft blocks break in one pulse. Harder blocks take multiple pulses and show a crack overlay. Blocks that require diamond or better (such as obsidian) are left alone.

Drops are pushed out the back like a dropper.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_block_:
A powered breaker with a configurable working volume. It automatically hits blocks while redstone allows it.

Base cycle is 40 ticks. Overclock upgrades can reduce this to 1 tick. Energy cost scales with distance and speed, and can be reduced with Efficiency upgrades. Harder blocks take multiple hits and extra energy.

Empty pickaxe slot = diamond harvest level. Inserted pickaxe applies mining level, Fortune, Silk Touch, and Unbreaking. Supports ghost filters, range overlay, mute, and Energy upgrades.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.simple_block_pl:
Place facing any direction (including up or down). Has 9 inventory slots that hoppers can fill.

A redstone pulse picks a random block from the inventory and places it in front of the face.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_block_:
A powered placer with a 9-slot inventory and a configurable working volume. It automatically places blocks while redstone allows it.

Base cycle is 40 ticks. Overclock upgrades can reduce this to 1 tick. Energy cost scales with distance and speed, and can be reduced with Efficiency upgrades.

Supports ghost filters, range overlay, mute, and Energy upgrades. Hoppers can access the inventory.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.solar_furnace.s: This furnace needs a clear view of the sky.
The sun must be in the sky for this furnace to run.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.solar_furnace.i:
A furnace powered purely by sunlight.

Requires clear sky access and daytime. Speed is strongest at noon (about 70% of a normal furnace) and weaker near sunrise and sunset. Rain reduces output, and thunderstorms reduce it further. The furnace stops completely at night or when the sky is blocked.

Accepts Overclock upgrades. Experience is stored and awarded when taking the output.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.dev_null.info:
A handheld void filter.

Place an item in its slot. Once that stack reaches its limit, further pickups of that item are automatically destroyed. You can also insert items manually to destroy them.

The selected slot can be used as a stand-in for that item when interacting with the world.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_dev_nu:
An upgraded handheld void filter with expandable slots, multiple pages, and adjustable stack limits.

Place items in the filter slots to void matching pickups once each slot is full. Right-click a block to place from the selected slot.

Shift-right-click opens the configuration menu for slots, pages, stack size, and cosmetics.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.mini_chest.info: A tiny one-slot chest. Stores a single item stack and works with hoppers and other inventory automation.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.trash_can.info:
A single-slot disposal block. Keeps one stack of an item; anything beyond that is voided. Changing the stored item type voids the previous stack.

Ghost filter slots support blacklist or whitelist mode.
Emits a redstone pulse on a configurable cycle.

Interval is the full cycle length in ticks. Pulse length is how long the signal stays powered within each cycle.

The spinning face is cosmetic and shows whether the clock is allowed to run.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.basic_item_coll:
Attach to any block face. Vacuums nearby item entities into the inventory behind it.

Supports blacklist or whitelist filtering, adjustable range, delay, and batch size. By default each pulse collects one item type. Accepts Range upgrades and one Stack upgrade (allows mixed types in a single pulse).
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_item_c:
Attach to any block face. Vacuums nearby item entities into the inventory behind it.

Supports blacklist or whitelist filtering, larger range and batch size, redstone control, and a range overlay. By default each pulse collects one item type. Accepts Range upgrades and one Stack upgrade (allows mixed types in a single pulse).
jei.dopasrandomutilities.simple_core_fra: A simple core block required by simple machines.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_core_f: An advanced core block required by more advanced machines.
Right-click a block to pack it. Sneak right-click a placed box to unwrap.
This block cannot be packed into a cardboard box.
Cannot unwrap the cardboard box here.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.tiny_tnt.info: A pocket-sized TNT. Lights the same way as vanilla TNT (flint and steel, fire charge, redstone, fire, or another explosion) and uses the same fuse flash, but the explosion is much smaller and higher-pitched.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.wood_chip.info:
Dropped when Tiny TNT explodes a wood log.

Always drops 1 chip, with a small chance for extras (50%, 25%, and 5%). Maximum of 4 chips.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.tran: Attach the plate to a source inventory. Matching items are pulled out and sent through connected pipes into inventories the pipes touch. Ghost filter slots support whitelist or blacklist (including the Filter item). Empty filters allow everything.
By default this head moves one item every 40 ticks. Overclock upgrades make it faster. Redstone control is available on the node plate.
Overclock upgrades speed this head up (maximum 11, down to 1 tick). One Stack upgrade allows up to 64 items per transfer, mixing types. Non-stackable items count as 1.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node.v: Visual only — shows the last pulled item
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.tran: Attach the plate to a source tank. Matching fluids are pulled out and sent through connected pipes into tanks the pipes touch. Ghost filter slots use buckets as fluid filters. Empty filters allow everything.
By default this head moves 100 mB every 60 ticks. Overclock upgrades make it faster. Redstone control is available on the node plate.
Overclock upgrades speed this head up (maximum 11, down to 1 tick). Fluid Capacity upgrades add +1x the base pull amount each cycle (maximum 64).
gui.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node_f: Visual only — shows the last pulled fluid
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.tran: Attach the plate to an energy buffer. Energy is pulled out and sent through connected pipes into machines or cells the pipes touch. This head has no item filter.
By default this head moves 200 FE/t every 20 ticks. Overclock upgrades make it faster. Redstone control is available on the node plate.
Overclock upgrades speed this head up (maximum 11, down to 1 tick). Energy upgrades increase the amount pulled each cycle (maximum 64). This head has no internal buffer.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_pipe.i:
Connects transfer nodes to nearby inventories.

Shift-right-click the middle of two pipes with an empty hand to connect or disconnect them.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node.i:
Attach to a source inventory. Pulls matching items through connected pipes into inventories the pipes touch.

Default rate: 1 item every 40 ticks. Overclock upgrades reduce the interval (down to 1 tick). One Stack upgrade allows up to 64 mixed items per transfer.

Ghost filters support whitelist or blacklist (including Filter items). Empty filters allow everything. Redstone control is available per head.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node_f:
Attach to a source tank. Pulls matching fluids through connected pipes into tanks the pipes touch.

Default rate: 100 mB every 60 ticks. Overclock upgrades reduce the interval. Fluid Capacity upgrades add +1x the base pull amount per upgrade.

Ghost filters use buckets. Empty filters allow every fluid. Redstone control is available per head.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node_e:
Attach to an energy buffer. Pulls energy through connected pipes into machines or cells the pipes touch.

Default rate: 200 FE/t every 20 ticks. Overclock upgrades reduce the interval. Energy upgrades increase the amount pulled each cycle.

This head has no item filter and no internal energy buffer. Redstone control is available per head.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.filter.ghost: Click with an item to set a filter
jei.dopasrandomutilities.filter.info:
A reusable item and fluid matcher.

Right-click to open a 4×4 ghost list with Match/Ignore toggles for NBT, damage, and item tags. Nested Filters are allowed. Works in every machine that has filter slots.
On powered machines, each upgrade adds more energy buffer and intake capacity (maximum 64).

On energy transfer nodes, each upgrade increases the amount of energy pulled per cycle. Nodes have no internal buffer.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.fluid_capacity_: Used by fluid transfer nodes. Each upgrade adds +1x the base pull amount per cycle (maximum 64).
jei.dopasrandomutilities.efficiency_upgr: Reduces the energy cost of each operation by 6% per upgrade (maximum 15 upgrades = 90% reduction).
jei.dopasrandomutilities.range_upgrade.i: Adds %s to max working range per upgrade.
A crafting component used to make machine upgrades. Has no effect on its own.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.productivity_up:
Increases the output of compatible machines.

Each upgrade adds a percentage bonus to the amount produced.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.overclock_upgra:
Increases the speed of compatible machines.

Each upgrade shortens process time. On powered breakers and placers, the base cycle is 40 ticks and can be reduced to 1 tick (maximum 11 upgrades). Faster cycles cost more energy.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.stack_upgrade.i:
Used by item transfer nodes and item collectors (maximum 1).

On item nodes: each transfer can move up to 64 items of mixed types. Non-stackable items count as 1.

On item collectors: without this upgrade each pulse locks to one item type. With the Stack upgrade, a single pulse can collect mixed types (still limited by the batch setting).
jei.dopasrandomutilities.fortune_mesh_up:
Fishnet-only upgrade. Unlocks vanilla treasure fishing in open water and raises the chance to force a treasure catch (up to 90%).

Without this upgrade the fishnet only catches fish and junk. Treasure Mesh overwrites this loot while installed. Does nothing in small ponds where treasure cannot drop.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.treasure_mesh_u: Fishnet-only upgrade. While installed, every catch rolls from a custom loot table instead of vanilla fishing loot (and overwrites Fortune Mesh).
Weights are relative — higher weight is more likely. They do not add up to 100%.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.stone:
A resource generator. Place matching blocks or fluids on its sides (and optionally below) to match a recipe. Output is inserted into any inventory above the generator.

Some side resources are kept; others are consumed after a full cycle. Lock Output remembers the last successful recipe. Accepts Productivity and Overclock upgrades (except Creative variants), plus redstone control.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.rando: A special resource generator that places ore blocks above itself when its recipe conditions are met.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.metal: A special resource generator that places metal blocks above itself when its recipe conditions are met.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.creat: Creative variant: upgrades cannot be installed.
Ticks between pickup attempts. Higher values slow collection. Use ∞ to pause.
How many items to pull in each attempt. Without a Stack upgrade, only one item type is collected per pulse.
Portal particles when items are collected
These sliders change the color of the range highlight
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.item: Collects items in its pickup range and inserts them into the attached block.

Switch between blacklist and whitelist to choose what gets picked up. Set range, delay, and batch size in the Configuration panel. Each pulse collects one item type unless a Stack upgrade is installed.

Switch between blacklist and whitelist to choose what gets picked up. Set range, delay, and batch size in the Configuration panel. Each pulse collects one item type unless a Stack upgrade is installed.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.item_magnet.inf:
A handheld magnet. Right-click to turn it on or off. Sneak-right-click to open its filter and settings.

Works from anywhere in your inventory. Attract mode pulls items toward you; Collect mode teleports them to your feet so vanilla pickup (and /dev/null) can take them. Accepts Range, Overclock, and Stack upgrades.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.item_magnet.mod: Attract pulls items toward you. Collect teleports them to your feet for vanilla pickup.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.item_magnet.pul: Also attract experience orbs in range
gui.dopasrandomutilities.item_magnet.pau: Stop pulling while you are sneaking
gui.dopasrandomutilities.item_magnet.ign: Pull and pick up items immediately, including fresh drops and your own throws.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.item_magnet.par: Spark particles when items are pulled
gui.dopasrandomutilities.item_magnet.cos: These sliders change the color of the active overlay
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.item: Pulls nearby dropped items toward you. Right-click toggles it; sneak-right-click opens this menu. It works from anywhere in your inventory, and only one magnet is active at a time.
Filter what it pulls with the ghost wells. Configuration sets range, Attract vs Collect, XP orbs, sneak pause, and pickup delay. Range, Overclock, and Stack upgrades fit in the upgrade panel.

jei.dopasrandomutilities.lasso.info:
Captures weak mobs; the mob must be under 18 health and be a non-boss. Capturing the mob it's free and releasing cost 1 item durability.

Not enchantable or repairable.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.golden_lasso.in: Captures any non-boss mob. Costs 1 experience level to capture and 1 to release. Infinite uses.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.cursed_lasso.in:
Captures non-boss mobs for 1 heart of damage, or bosses at 5% HP or below for 4 hearts of damage. Release is free. 

Right-click a spawner while holding a captured mob to rewrite it (consumes the lasso on success).
